description: Severe flash flooding across KL and Selangor caused by intense rainfall exceeding 100mm in 3 hours

warnings.title_bm: Amaran Cuaca Buruk: Hujan Sangat Lebat
warnings.title_en: Severe Weather Warning: Very Heavy Rain
warnings.description_bm: Hujan sangat lebat dijangka di Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, dan Putrajaya. Risiko banjir kilat tinggi di kawasan rendah.
warnings.description_en: Very heavy rain expected in Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, and Putrajaya. High flash flood risk in low-lying areas.

warnings.description_bm: Paras air Sg Gombak di stesen Wangsa Maju telah melepasi paras bahaya. Penduduk diminta berpindah segera.
warnings.description_en: Water level at Sg Gombak Wangsa Maju station has exceeded danger level. Residents are urged to evacuate immediately.
